answers.goal: I’d love to work in marketing within the entertainment industry and experience the behind-the-scenes! Whether I’m working directly for the companies or partnering with them for brand activations, my goal is to be the person behind all the campaigns and events people see on social media.
answers.drew: Growing up constantly in front of the screen, I’ve always been drawn to entertainment as it felt like an escape from reality. When I got to college and learned the different industries within marketing, I realized that it’s possible to work behind-the-scenes for the companies of shows/movies I grew up watching.
answers.seeking: Like-minded people with diverse backgrounds! As someone currently in beauty marketing, I’d love to learn more about entertainment through different eyes.
answers.inspiration: My parents: hard-working immigrants who will stop at nothing to help their children succeed.
